rejected_rule.statement: A plaintiff cannot rely on a ground of exemption from the law of limitation raised for the first time in the Appeal Court.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: The judgment of the Commercial High Court did so on the basis that the acknowledgement of debt “... was not by letter X11(a) dated 09.11.2007 but by letter X2 dated 21.03.2003” issued well over seven years.
